I just posted this on a [macworld thread](http://www.macworld.com/forums/ubbthreads/showflat.php?Cat=0&Number=497612&an=0&page=0#497612), but i’ll republish it as a rant.

`<font class="post">`{=html}I have a Microsoft Natural Keyboard\
Elite USB keyboard plugged into my PowerBook G4.\
`</font>`{=html}

![MS NaturalKeyboard Elite](http://mineko.fc2web.com/box/kb-room/items/res/natukey-elite/mainimg.jpg)

`<font class="post">`{=html}It’s been pretty good for my wrists, and it’s cheap, too.`</font>`{=html}

`<font class="post">`{=html}I recently `</font>`{=html} `<font class="post">`{=html}had to do a\
pair of Archive and Install’s on the PowerBook, and I lost the kernel extensions\
that made the Microsoft keyboard more like a mac (swapping alt and\
command keys, etc).`</font>`{=html}

`<font class="post">`{=html}I went to [Microsoft’s download page](http://www.microsoft.com/hardware/mouseandkeyboard/Download.mspx){target="_blank"}\
and they don’t have a listing for the Natural Keyboard Elite anymore.\
The latest keyboard driver is Intellitype 6.2, though. I downloaded and\
installed that, and even though I can click “swap alt and command” in\
the preference panel, it has no effect.`</font>`{=html} `<font class="post">`{=html} I’ve installed Intellitype 5.4, 6.0, 6.1, and 6.2, and all of\
them aren’t working out-of-the-box.`</font>`{=html}

`<font class="post">`{=html}I’ve also discovered that\
when I select Keyboard Info from the Intellitype about window, it tells\
me that no Microsoft Keyboards have been found. Why not? I repeat, this\
*used* to work.`</font>`{=html}

`<font class="post">`{=html}I’m using [doubleCommand](http://doublecommand.sourceforge.net/) now ([uControl](http://gnufoo.org/ucontrol/) is another option), but what was\
nice about Intellitype was it only went into effect when the keyboard\
was installed. With the laptop on its own it would revert to normal. `</font>`{=html}
